memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been noticing mild aches in my thighs and calves since starting fenofibrate a few months ago. It worsens after walking. Could this be a side effect?

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: On rosuvastatin 10 mg OD + fenofibrate 145 mg OD. Patient reports thigh/calf aches, CK 210 U/L (elevated). Weight 70 kg, waist 92 cm.
  - Plan: Stop fenofibrate due to possible myopathy; continue rosuvastatin; monitor CK in 4 weeks; advise hydration and gentle stretching.
